exercises.q: Несмотря на ___ (тёплое утро, acc. sg.), невыспавшиеся, зевавшие солдаты дрожали в своих каламянковых рубахах.
exercises.why: **утро → утро** (acc. sg.). Neuter, nominative singular in -о. Declines like DLI's окно — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. окно). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **тёплый → теплое** (acc. sg. n., agreeing with утро). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings): A. новое. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. утро · утра · утру · утро · утром · утре; pl. утра · утр · утрам · утра · утрами · утрах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Все испытанное им за ___ (последний месяц, acc. sg.) утвердило его отношение к жизни, к людям.

No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **последний → последний** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with месяц). Adjective type II, soft — declines like DLI's синий (every form has the same endings): A. anim. = G., inan. = N. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. месяц · месяца · месяцу · месяц · месяцем · месяце; pl. месяцы · месяцев · месяцам · месяцы · месяцами · месяцах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47. exercises.q: Беда была настолько велика, что изжить ее нужны не недели, не месяцы, — ___ (целый год, acc. pl.).
exercises.why: **год → годы** (acc. pl.). Masculine, inanimate; nominative plural годы. Declines like DLI's стол — every plural form has the same endings (A. pl. столы). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. год · года · году · год · годом · годе; pl. годы · годов · годам · годы · годами · годах.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Notice that the adjectives of the "soft", "guttural" and "sibilant" types are declined in the plural in the very same way.» — DLI, Lesson 48. exercises.q: А их нельзя разве читать в ___ (другой день, acc. pl.)?
exercises.why: **день → дни** (acc. pl.). Masculine, inanimate; nominative plural дни. Declines like DLI's автомобиль — every plural form has the same endings (A. pl. автомобили). Ending -ь → -и, with the fleeting -е- of the stem dropped: дн- + -и.  **другой → другие** (acc. pl., agreeing with дни). Adjective type III, guttural (after г, к, х) — declines like DLI's русский (every form has the same endings, apart from the masculine nominative singular (and the inanimate accusative equal to it), which ends in -ой here, not -ий): A. anim. = G., inan. = N. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. день · дня · дню · день · днём · дне; pl. дни · дней · дням · дни · днями · днях.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Masculine adjectives of the "hard" and "guttural" types have in the nominative the ending -ой if stressed: новый — молодой; русский — плохой, and retain the stress on the ending throughout the declension.» «The adjective «большой» belongs to the guttural type, in spite of its -ш-: большого, большому, большим, о большом.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Notice that the adjectives of the "soft", "guttural" and "sibilant" types are declined in the plural in the very same way.» — DLI, Lesson 48.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).
